Yosetsu Awase (Provisional License).name: Yosetsu Awase (Provisional License)
Yosetsu Awase (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Yosetsu Awase, hero name Welder, a Class 1-B first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who holds a provisional hero license: 1-B took the exam at a different venue from 1-A, and the whole class passed. Black hair under a striped headband, gray eyes, a sturdy build; the U.A. uniform or his burgundy hero costume.
Speaking Style: Direct and informal; quick warnings.
Combat Role: Hands-on support whose welded restraints and braces go up fast; still contact-only.
Under Pressure: Warns his side, keeps the rescue route clear and acts on his license in an emergency.
Yosetsu Awase (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The summer gave his careful checks real stakes: he must bond fast without trapping the wrong person. Motivation: Prove practical support belongs at the center of rescue work. Connections: Vlad King, prouder than ever of 1-B's full pass. Thread: What kind of hero a contact-only Quirk makes of him.
QUIRK: Weld: practiced speed; still contact-only.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; holds a provisional license. All Might retired after Kamino.
personality: Helpful: Steps in to protect someone the moment a practical opening appears.
Pragmatic: Reads a rescue scene for what can be braced, anchored or joined.
Careful bonder: Confirms who a weld might trap, even at speed.
Speaking style: Direct, informal warnings; short and practical, no speeches.
abilities: Weld: Fuses touched objects into one piece with practiced speed; contact only, no undoing from afar.
Capture weld: Fixes a restraint or object onto a target to pin them; he must reach them first.
Emergency bracing: Bonds debris into a rescue support, only as strong as the materials.
Provisional license: May act with his Quirk in an emergency; it does not make him a pro.
Fighting style: Closes to touch range and welds an opponent in place for a teammate; at range he relies on cover.
Yosetsu Awase (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young man with black hair swept up and back under a striped headband, gray eyes, fair skin and a sturdy build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. Steady, confident expression with a slight grin.
